topic: Which extraordinary world would you explore?

files.name: 01.png
files.label: MOONLIT OBSERVATORY
files.must_show: A large brass telescope dominates an open domed observatory
files.observed_subject: A monumental brass telescope stands in a domed observatory opening onto a moonlit desert.

files.name: 02.png
files.label: AURORA ICE THRONE
files.must_show: An ice throne stands amid towering crystals and glowing lanterns
files.observed_subject: A large translucent ice throne with white fur sits within a crystal cavern beneath northern lights.

files.name: 03.png
files.label: ENCHANTED TREE LIBRARY
files.must_show: A book-filled library room is built into a giant tree
files.observed_subject: An illuminated book-filled reading room is built into a huge tree above a misty valley.

files.name: 04.png
files.label: SUNSET COASTAL GATE
files.must_show: A tall wooden door with a golden sun emblem stands in a stone archway
files.observed_subject: A large carved wooden door bearing a sun emblem opens within a stone arch toward the coast.

files.name: 05.png
files.label: WATERFALL CLIFF CITY
files.must_show: A white stone fantasy city with towers and bridges occupies towering waterfall cliffs
files.observed_subject: A white stone cliffside city with domes, bridges and waterfalls rises above the clouds.
